_achieved_rung_note: THE LADDER TIER, which is what scripts/check_rung_freshness.py accepts. The frozen E1 ladder is [30,100,189,279,340,403,568] and 143 is NOT a member of it, so passing 143 makes the gate exit 2. The contiguous seed depth is 143 and is recorded separately below. Reporting the depth as though it were a rung would claim a ladder tier the study has not reached.
definition: contiguous_seed_depth is the largest n such that EVERY arm of EVERY line holds a complete contiguous seed prefix 0..n-1 with an archived record.json. achieved_rung is the highest frozen-ladder tier at or below that depth.
shallowest_cell: test_leg_nemotron_3_super/placebo: 204 records, complete prefix 0..142, first hole at seed 143
why_contiguous_and_not_distinct_count: a paired contrast can only use seeds present in every arm it compares, and the CRN pairing is by seed index, so a complete prefix is the honest depth. Every distinct-count figure is larger than what a paired analysis may actually use, so quoting one would overstate the depth.
counting_defect_found_2026-08-10: notebooks/preliminary_results.ipynb computed each arm's depth as a RECORD COUNT and therefore reported rung 189. The count minimum is 202 and the contiguous minimum is 143, because nemotron/placebo is missing seeds 143 and 144 while holding 204 records above them. The notebook was corrected to use the contiguous prefix. THE HONEST BANKED RUNG IS 100; RUNG 189 IS NOT BANKED.
